# Junya Honda — Personal Academic Website

> Master's student in Computer Science at Toyohashi University of Technology.
> Research focus: brain signal analysis using Graph Neural Networks and Explainable AI techniques, working with iEEG data.

- Explainable AI (XAI)
- Brain-Computer Interface / Neural Signal Analysis
